name: esports_hub
archetype: Competitive esports organization and gaming news hub
market: Global, 16-30 competitive gaming audience, fans of major esports titles
density: High energy, high density, but in a structured magazine style. Above the fold: live match ticker. Below: news grid mixed with match schedule. Team roster section. Tournament brackets. Stream embeds. Discord join CTA. Everything maximally visual and action-oriented.
nav_style: Dark to black background with team logo/org name left. Nav: News, Teams, Schedule, Results, Shop, Watch. Live match score ticker runs below the nav continuously. 'Watch Live' button in neon red pulsing animation. Social icons row. Discord join in contrasting accent color.
commercial_model: Fan-funded esports org. Revenue from merch shop, sponsor logos prominently displayed (Intel, Corsair, Red Bull, regional banks), fan membership subscriptions, and tournament prize money visibility.
color_palette: Near-black (#0D0D0D) background. Electric red (#FF0033) as primary team accent. White (#FFFFFF) for primary text. Medium grey (#888888) for secondary text and dividers. Gold (#FFD700) for championship badges, win records, and prize amounts. Live badge: #FF0033 red with white text. Ticker background: #1A1A1A. Player card hover glow: box-shadow 0 0 24px rgba(255,0,51,0.6) — use team red color for glow.
typography: Barlow Condensed or Rajdhani for headlines — aggressive, condensed, game-like. Roboto for body text. Stats and numbers in a bold monospace. Player names in all-caps. Team names in organization typeface. Score displays in large tabular numerals.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Hero with featured match or announcement. Live match ticker below nav. News grid with video thumbnails. Upcoming matches schedule table. Roster spotlight section. Sponsor logos strip. Social media feed integration.

pages.title: Our Teams
pages.description: Teams by game: League of Legends, Valorant, CS2, Rocket League. Each team card with logo, game icon, current ranking, record. Click to team page with roster.

pages.title: Player Roster
pages.description: Player roster page for one team. Player cards with professional photo, IGN (in-game name), real name, role/position, country flag, and social links. Coach and analysts section. Staff section.

pages.title: Schedule & Results
pages.description: Upcoming and past matches organized by tournament. Match cards with opponent logo, date/time, tournament name, game, and stream link. Results show score. Filter by team or game.

pages.title: Merch Shop
pages.description: Team merchandise store. Jersey section, hoodies, accessories, mousepads. Product cards with photo, name, price, size selector. Limited edition drops countdown timer. Signed merch section.
